deck_title: Competitive Blind Spot: Intelligence Before Creative

slides.title: The Insight: We Have IDs, Not Intelligence
bullets: Dove ad IDs identified: 2 assets flagged in dataset
Zero tactical metadata: No hooks, arcs, or visual cues mapped
Analysis impossible without full creative assets and timestamps
slides.notes: Opening with the hard truth from the JSON analysis: the dataset contains only ad identifiers without required metadata for competitive deconstruction.

slides.title: The Risk: Flying Blind Into Production
bullets: Unmapped competitive landscape risks wasted media spend
No visibility into Dove's emotional beats or messaging cadence
Danger of unintentional imitation or missed differentiation
slides.notes: Highlighting the business risk of creating counter-creative without knowing what we are countering.

slides.title: The Pivot: Procurement First
bullets: Immediate procurement of full video assets required
Frame-by-frame temporal mapping of hooks and visual patterns
Only then can exploitable positioning gaps emerge
slides.notes: The necessary intermediate step before any creative work can begin.

slides.title: Counter-Creative Recommendation: Pause & Audit
bullets: Suspend Nivea creative production pending competitive intelligence
Audit Dove's full creative archive with metadata extraction
Draft counter-creative only after verified gap analysis complete
slides.notes: The counter-creative recommendation is strategic patience: we cannot recommend creative angles until we analyze actual content. This prevents budget waste.
